method: python training/benchmark_sequential.py --data-dir ml-32m Reviewers ask whether a sequential model was tried. This is the classic one that needs no GPU: a first-order Markov chain over each viewer's time-ordered likes (how often movie j is liked within the next 3 likes after movie i), blended with item-kNN so unseen transitions still score. Same 1-in-5 MovieLens 32M sample, time split, and 3,000 validation / 3,000 test viewers as benchmark_cf.py, scored from each viewer's 3 most recent likes. Rules written before running: the blend weight is picked on validation viewers, then compared once on test viewers with item-kNN alone (paired bootstrap). It is reported either way; it would only enter the app if it wins with a 95% interval above zero. Writes data/sequential_results.json.
